description: Land Title Settlement Department - Walgama South, Matara D/S Division, Matara District Case. No. 820030 (24/1046)
categorisation: This gazette content specifically deals with land title registration under the Registration of Title Act, No. 21 of 1998. It contains a declaration by the Commissioner of Title Settlement regarding the determination of title to a specific parcel of land (Parcel No. 1:169 of Block 03) with detailed land particulars including location, extent, ownership details, and encumbrances. The content falls under "PART III - LANDS" and focuses exclusively on land registration matters, making it a clear example of Type 4 (Land Gazettes) according to the classification criteria.
